title: Deep-learning structure prediction yields a nanobody aggregation score
summary: Structures of VHH nanobodies were predicted by deep learning and framework region 2 properties were combined into an aggregation score. A total of 106 nanobody variants were expressed and characterized by size exclusion chromatography, and the abstract reports a clear correlation between the score and aggregation of VHH Fc-fusion proteins. The strength of the correlation is not quantified in the abstract.
ai_technology: Deep learning-based VHH structure prediction with framework-region-2 patch properties combined into an aggregation score

evidence.tested: 106 variants produced and aggregation measured by size exclusion chromatography; correlation with score.
evidence.unknown: Correlation strength and generality beyond VHH; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning structure prediction feeding an aggregation score

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; author affiliations from the same record. Publisher full text not accessed.
